title: Spare room storage sharing
summary: Store your stuff in a neighbour's spare room or garage.
whyTempting: Self-storage is expensive and spare space is abundant.
whyItFails: Trust. Strangers holding belongings is risky. Insurance. Coverage is complicated. Low engagement. Hosts lose interest.
whatWouldChange: Insurance products tailored for P2P storage.

attempts.outcome: Shut down; storage business sold to Clutter
Sold its valet-storage operation and pivoted to software

attempts.notes: On-demand storage; all-equity merger to get the scale logistics businesses need. Not peer-to-peer, but the same storage problem.

reasons.detail: Trust: Strangers holding belongings is risky.
